title: Rebalance — 6 channel stock-outs with sister-channel excess

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

checks.text: No source node drops under its own floor — DC-East keeps 2.4 weeks after T-142.
Every scheduled lane clears the 1.5× economics floor.
2,260 units fits pick capacity across two waves.
One lane per SKU per cycle · no SKU appears twice on the slate.

slate.name: Ridgeline mug + bowl → FBA-West

options.name: Transfer
options.note: Restores Buy Box on both SKUs and serves the demand DC-East cannot reach.

options.name: Expedite
options.note: Air freight lands Aug 27 instead of Sep 02. Costs $1.9K more for five days.

options.name: Hold
options.note: Wait for the supplier K PO on Sep 23. Three more weeks at zero on FBA-West.

slate.foot: Gates a budget shift in story 9.4

slate.name: Quilted oven mitt → DTC

options.name: Transfer
options.note: Moves units from $6.80 wholesale to $18.40 DTC. Cheapest lane on the board.

options.name: Expedite
options.note: Next-day air lands Aug 27. Rarely worth it on a lane this short.

options.name: Hold
options.note: DTC runs out in nine days and the mitt is in the Meta campaign from Sep 01.

slate.foot: Gates a budget shift in story 9.4

slate.name: Alder chef knife → FBA-East

options.name: Transfer
options.note: Lands one day after FBA-East runs dry. Better than a two-week gap.

options.name: Expedite
options.note: Cannot beat the removal window — FBA controls the first three days.

options.name: Hold
options.note: Eight days of cover left, then two weeks out until the next PO.

slate.foot: Pick wave and inbound plan create on approval

slate.name: Carbon steel pan → WFS

options.name: Transfer
options.note: Minimum move that clears the WFS floor. Realify does not fill this channel.

options.name: Expedite
options.note: WFS inbound appointments are the constraint, not the freight.

options.name: Hold
options.note: Four days of cover. WFS is the lowest-CM channel, so the loss is small.

slate.foot: Pick wave and inbound plan create on approval

slate.name: Ridgeline mug top-up → FBA-East

options.name: Transfer
options.note: FBA-East is at 1.6 weeks. This holds it above floor until the PO lands.

options.name: Expedite
options.note: Not needed — the clock is ten days and the lane is five.

options.name: Hold
options.note: Would drop under floor next week and risk Buy Box on a second node.

slate.foot: Pick wave and inbound plan create on approval

slate.name: Cut-glass tumbler → WFS

options.name: Hold
options.note: The Verrier PO lands Sep 18 with 900 units. Realify recommends waiting.

options.name: Transfer
options.note: Under the 1.5× economics floor. The unit sells either way, just later.

options.name: Expedite
options.note: Loses money outright once air freight is counted.

slate.foot: Held · no pick wave, no inbound plan
